responsibility: Declares the exported `function_base` objects for the SiFive custom vector intrinsic families. It provides the `bases::` namespace interface for SiFive-specific operations like `sf_vqmacc*` and `sf_vfnrclip*`, separating the intrinsic table declarations from the expansion logic implemented in sifive-vector-builtins-bases.cc.
same_name_distinction: This is the declaration side of the same-stem SiFive builtin-bases pair: it exposes extern bases:: function_base pointers for the SiFive custom vector intrinsic families, while sifive-vector-builtins-bases.cc defines the corresponding classes, expansion behavior, and object instances.
